_about: The golf-video call. Client CASE-043 calls during the simulated tech sell-off. client_voice is ElevenLabs 'Roger' (casual, middle-aged); the briefing voice is 'Alice'. pause_before is the silence before each line, which is where the advisor answers.

lines.text: Hi, it's Waldo. I just saw tech stocks are crashing. How much have I lost on tech?
And my world fund, is that hit by the dollar as well?
What about my bonds, are they holding up?
